lessons.title: How Do Families Celebrate Christmas?
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to describe one way their family celebrates Christmas or another winter celebration.
lessons.starter_activity: Discuss what children might see decorated at this time of year.
lessons.main_activity: Children share family traditions (tree, food, visiting relatives), noting that not everyone celebrates the same way.
key_questions: What does your family do to celebrate?
Does everyone celebrate the same way?

differentiation.extension: Compare own tradition to a friend's

lessons.assessment_notes: Note cultural awareness and inclusivity — evidence for UTW.2.
lessons.plenary: Class list of different family traditions.
lessons.home_link: Talk about your family's winter traditions.

lessons.title: Christmas Tree Decoration Craft
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to construct and decorate a simple hanging decoration.
lessons.starter_activity: Look at examples of tree decorations.
lessons.main_activity: Children make a simple salt-dough or card decoration, adding colour and pattern.
resources_needed: Salt dough or card, paint, ribbon, glitter
key_questions: What pattern/colour are you adding?
How will you hang it up?

differentiation.extension: Design own shape and detailed pattern

lessons.assessment_notes: Observe fine motor and creative choice — evidence for EAD.1/PD.2.
lessons.plenary: Display decorations on a class tree.
lessons.home_link: Help decorate a tree or space at home.

lessons.title: Phonics: Introducing 'w'
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to say the sound 'w' and blend words (wig, wet, win).
lessons.starter_activity: Recap sounds learned so far.
lessons.main_activity: Introduce 'w' sound/action; blend new CVC words.
key_questions: What sound is this?
Can you blend w-i-g?

differentiation.extension: Write CVC words independently

lessons.assessment_notes: Update phonics tracker for 'w'.
lessons.plenary: Sing all 21 sounds learned.
lessons.home_link: Practise blending wig, wet, win.

lessons.title: Counting Baubles on the Tree
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to count decorations accurately up to 10.
lessons.starter_activity: Count baubles on a class tree picture together.
lessons.main_activity: Children count and hang a given number of bauble counters onto a paper tree, checking accuracy.
key_questions: How many baubles are on your tree?
Can you count them again to check?

differentiation.extension: Count to 10+ and compare with a partner's tree

lessons.assessment_notes: Record counting accuracy — evidence for MATHS.1.
lessons.plenary: Class total bauble count.
lessons.home_link: Count decorations at home together.

lessons.title: Christmas Around the World
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to recognise that Christmas/winter celebrations look different in different countries.
lessons.starter_activity: Look at a simple world map.
lessons.main_activity: Discuss how Christmas is celebrated differently in a few countries (e.g. snow in some places, sunshine in Australia), noting variety.
resources_needed: World map, photos of Christmas in different countries
key_questions: What is different about Christmas in this country?
What is the same?

differentiation.extension: Locate countries on the map and compare 3+

lessons.assessment_notes: Note broadened cultural/geographic awareness — evidence for UTW.2.
lessons.plenary: Recap different Christmas traditions worldwide.
lessons.home_link: Find a country on a map and imagine its Christmas traditions.

lessons.title: Christmas Song and Dance
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to sing a Christmas song with actions confidently.
lessons.starter_activity: Listen to a familiar Christmas song.
lessons.main_activity: Learn a simple Christmas song with actions, practising with increasing confidence and volume control.
key_questions: What action goes with this line?
Can you sing it a little louder/softer?

differentiation.extension: Suggest and lead a new action

lessons.assessment_notes: Observe participation and expressive movement — evidence for EAD.2.
lessons.plenary: Perform the song once more.
lessons.home_link: Sing the Christmas song for family.

lessons.title: Story Time: 'The Nativity' (Simple Retelling)
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to name the key characters in the Nativity story.
lessons.starter_activity: Look at a simple Nativity scene picture.
lessons.main_activity: Tell a simple, age-appropriate version of the Nativity story, introducing key characters.
key_questions: Who are the characters in this story?
Where was baby Jesus born?

differentiation.extension: Retell part of the story in own words

lessons.assessment_notes: Note comprehension and recall — evidence for LIT.1/UTW.2.
lessons.plenary: Recap the Nativity characters together.
lessons.home_link: Share a Nativity story or nativity scene with family if relevant.

lessons.title: Wrapping Paper Patterns
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to continue and create a repeating pattern for wrapping paper.
lessons.starter_activity: Look at wrapping paper examples with patterns.
lessons.main_activity: Children continue a given pattern and design their own repeating pattern for pretend wrapping paper using stamps/stickers.
key_questions: What comes next in this pattern?
Can you make your own pattern?

differentiation.extension: Create own complex pattern (ABC, ABBA)

lessons.assessment_notes: Note pattern recognition and creation — evidence for MATHS.2.
lessons.plenary: Display and admire patterned wrapping paper.
lessons.home_link: Look for patterns on wrapping paper or fabric at home.

lessons.title: Winter Weather and Snow
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to describe what snow feels/looks like or predict what would happen to ice.
lessons.starter_activity: Discuss if children have seen snow before.
lessons.main_activity: (If snow available, explore outside; otherwise) explore ice cubes melting, discussing changes of state simply.
resources_needed: Ice cubes, trays, or real snow if available
key_questions: What happens to the ice?
Why does it melt?

differentiation.extension: Predict and check melting time

lessons.assessment_notes: Note investigative observation — evidence for UTW.3.
lessons.plenary: Recap what happened to the ice/snow.
lessons.home_link: Explore ice or cold weather together if possible.

lessons.title: Making Christmas Cards
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to design and decorate a card for a chosen recipient.
lessons.starter_activity: Look at examples of Christmas/winter cards.
lessons.main_activity: Children design and decorate a card using craft materials, choosing who to give it to.
key_questions: Who is your card for?
How are you decorating it?

differentiation.extension: Design own layout and add a written message

lessons.assessment_notes: Observe creative design and fine motor skill — evidence for EAD.1/PD.2.
lessons.plenary: Share who cards are for.
lessons.home_link: Give your card to the person it's for.

lessons.title: Writing Christmas Card Messages
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to attempt to write a simple greeting inside their card.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap sounds learned so far.
lessons.main_activity: Children attempt to write a simple message (e.g. 'to mum') inside their card from the EAD lesson, using known sounds.
key_questions: Who is the card to?
What sound does that word start with?

differentiation.extension: Independent phonetic attempt

lessons.assessment_notes: Note purposeful writing attempt — evidence for LIT.3.
lessons.plenary: Share written messages with a partner.
lessons.home_link: Write a message in a card for a family member.

lessons.title: Counting Down to Christmas: Advent
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to use a calendar to count days and understand 'counting down'.
lessons.starter_activity: Look at an advent calendar example.
lessons.main_activity: Children explore a simple class advent-style countdown, counting how many days until a target date.
resources_needed: Advent calendar or simple countdown chart
key_questions: How many days until [date]?
What happens as the number gets smaller?

differentiation.extension: Explain the countdown concept independently

lessons.assessment_notes: Note understanding of counting down/calendar concepts — evidence for MATHS.1/UTW.1.
lessons.plenary: Recap the countdown so far.
lessons.home_link: Use an advent calendar or countdown together at home.

lessons.title: Giving and Kindness at Christmas
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to describe why giving to others is a part of many winter celebrations.
lessons.starter_activity: Discuss how it feels to give someone a gift.
lessons.main_activity: Discuss the idea of giving/kindness at this time of year; children think of something kind they could give (not necessarily a物 object — could be help, a hug, a smile).
key_questions: What could you give that isn't a toy?
How does giving make you feel?

differentiation.extension: Suggest own idea of non-material giving

lessons.assessment_notes: Note prosocial and reflective thinking — evidence for UTW.2/PSED.3.
lessons.plenary: Class list of kind things to give this week.
lessons.home_link: Do one kind 'giving' act for someone at home this week.

lessons.title: Christmas Role-Play: Post Office/Santa's Workshop
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to engage in imaginative role-play within a themed corner.
lessons.starter_activity: Discuss what happens at a post office or Santa's workshop (imaginative).
lessons.main_activity: Free role-play in a themed post office/workshop corner, wrapping pretend parcels and 'posting' cards made this week.
resources_needed: Role-play props, empty boxes, play stamps
key_questions: What are you sending?
Who is it for?

differentiation.extension: Child extends the scenario with own ideas

lessons.assessment_notes: Observe imaginative language and role engagement — evidence for EAD.2/CL.2.
lessons.plenary: Share what was 'posted' today.
lessons.home_link: Post a real card or letter with a family member if possible.

lessons.title: Story Time: 'The Jolly Christmas Postman' or Similar
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to retell one event from the story.
lessons.starter_activity: Predict from the cover.
lessons.main_activity: Read the story, pausing to discuss the different letters/parcels delivered to storybook characters.
key_questions: Who did the postman visit?
What was inside the letters?

differentiation.extension: Retell an event in full sentences

lessons.assessment_notes: Note comprehension and recall — evidence for LIT.1.
lessons.plenary: Discuss favourite part of the story.
lessons.home_link: Retell the story to someone at home.

lessons.title: Maths Review: Counting, Pattern, Countdown
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to apply counting, pattern, and countdown skills learned this week.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap the week's maths vocabulary.
lessons.main_activity: Rotate through 3 stations: counting baubles, wrapping paper pattern recap, advent countdown recap.
key_questions: How many is this?
What comes next in the pattern?
How many days until the date?

differentiation.extension: Independent completion with recording

lessons.assessment_notes: Summarise week 13 maths observations.
lessons.plenary: Class recap game combining all three skills.
lessons.home_link: Continue practising counting and patterns over the weekend.

lessons.title: Christmas Traditions Recap Display
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to summarise key facts about Christmas/winter traditions learned this week.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap the week's UTW learning.
lessons.main_activity: Contribute to a class 'Winter Celebrations' display summarising traditions, giving, and worldwide differences discussed this week.
key_questions: What did we learn about winter celebrations?
What was most interesting?

differentiation.extension: Explain multiple ideas with reasoning

lessons.assessment_notes: Note synthesis of the week's learning — evidence for UTW.2.
lessons.plenary: Unveil the finished display.
lessons.home_link: Share what you learned about winter celebrations with your family.

lessons.title: Phonics Review: All 21 Sounds
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to blend and read CVC words and simple sentences using all sounds learned so far.
lessons.starter_activity: Quick-fire flashcard review of all 21 sounds.
lessons.main_activity: Phonics stations: word-building, CVC reading cards, simple sentence reading (e.g. 'the van is wet').
key_questions: Can you build and read this word?
Can you read this sentence?

differentiation.extension: Read simple sentences independently

lessons.assessment_notes: Finalise week 13 phonics tracker.
lessons.plenary: Celebrate all sounds learned with a reading game.
lessons.home_link: Practise reading simple sentences over the holidays.

lessons.title: Christmas Celebration Performance
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to perform the week's song with confidence as a celebration.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap all elements learned this week.
lessons.main_activity: Whole-class performance of the Christmas song/dance, with decorations and cards displayed.
resources_needed: Craft made this week, music player
key_questions: What was your favourite part of this week?
How did it feel to perform?

differentiation.extension: Lead a movement or verse

lessons.assessment_notes: Observe confidence and enjoyment — evidence for EAD.2.
lessons.plenary: Round of applause; recap the festive week.
lessons.home_link: Perform the song/dance for family this weekend.

lessons.title: Autumn Term Maths Recap Game
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to demonstrate progress across the term's key maths skills in a celebratory game.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap key maths learning from across the whole autumn term.
lessons.main_activity: Play a whole-term recap game/board game combining counting, shape, pattern, and number bond questions.
resources_needed: Term recap board game or station resources
key_questions: What have you learned this term in maths?
What are you most proud of?

differentiation.extension: Lead questions for peers

lessons.assessment_notes: Summarise Autumn term maths progress overall — evidence for MATHS.1/MATHS.2 across the term.
lessons.plenary: Celebrate everyone's maths progress this term.
lessons.home_link: Practise favourite maths games together over the holidays.
